Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllInfoDistanc:
0 = no distance limit (default).
N > 0 = global display-distance cap for zombie dots, animals,
vehicles, safehouse outlines, resource points (POI)
and custom zones.
Highest priority: per-type distance options can only tighten it
(the smaller value wins), never loosen it.
Players can further tighten their own distances in the
settings window's Display distance section.
One tile is about one metre; distance is 2D and ignores floors.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowZombieDot: Allow players to show real-time zombie positions within the mini-map view. When disabled, the feature is turned off for every player (admin changes apply live).
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapZombieDotDista:
0 = no distance limit.
N > 0 = show only items within N tiles of the player.
One tile is about one metre; distance is 2D and ignores floors.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowZombieInt: Allow players to overlay the zombie population heatmap on the mini-map. When disabled it is force-hidden (admin changes apply live).
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapSafehouseDispl: Controls safehouse area outlines and icons on players' mini-maps: off / own only / all (including other players') / own and faction members'. PVP servers may prefer "Own only" or "Own and faction" to avoid leaking enemy base locations.

0 = no distance limit.
N > 0 = show an outline only when its nearest point
is within N tiles of the player.
One tile is about one metre; distance is 2D and ignores floors.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
This only controls outline visibility.
It does not affect livestock ownership or privacy checks.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapSafehouseNameD: Controls safehouse names (the safehouse title) on players' mini-maps: off / own only / all / own and faction members'. Independent from the area display, so areas can be shown without names.

0 = no distance limit.
N > 0 = show a name only when the area's nearest point
is within N tiles of the player.
Independent from the outline distance. One tile is about one metre;
distance is 2D and ignores floors.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowNavShare_: Allow players to share navigation targets with faction members (relayed by the server). When disabled the server rejects share requests.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowAnimalDot: Allow players to show nearby animal icons (wild and livestock) on the mini-map. When disabled, the feature is turned off for every player (admin changes apply live).
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAnimalIconDist:
0 = no distance limit.
N > 0 = show only items within N tiles of the player.
One tile is about one metre; distance is 2D and ignores floors.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapLivestockVisib:
Controls livestock icon visibility.
The "Hide inside other safehouses" mode
still shows livestock outside safehouses.
Your safehouses are based on the animal's current location;
you must own or be invited to that safehouse.
This is not animal ownership or anti-cheat;
wild animals are unaffected.
In singleplayer, the first three modes all show livestock.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowVehicleDo: Allow players to show nearby vehicle icons on the mini-map. When disabled, the feature is turned off for every player (admin changes apply live).
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapVehicleIconDis:
0 = no distance limit.
N > 0 = show only items within N tiles of the player.
One tile is about one metre; distance is 2D and ignores floors.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapPoiDisplayDist:
0 = no distance limit (default).
N > 0 = a resource point (blocks, outlines and icon) is shown only
when the nearest point of its displayed rooms is within N tiles
of the player.
One tile is about one metre; 300 is a good starting value
(roughly a city block cluster) that preserves exploration.
Only affects built-in resource points; map-pack outlines
and other layers are unaffected.
Distance is 2D and ignores floors.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapZoneDisplayDis:
0 = no distance limit (default).
N > 0 = a custom zone (supplied by a zone-layer add-on,
such as server regions) is shown only when its nearest point
is within N tiles of the player (fill, border, name and icon
are hidden together).
Only affects the custom zone layer; resource points and
map-pack outlines are unaffected.
Players can further tighten this with their own slider
(the smaller value wins).
One tile is about one metre; distance is 2D and ignores floors.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapExportPlayerPo:
Write player positions to a JSON file for external tools (off by default).
Output goes to Zomboid/Lua/MinidoracatMiniMap/ as players_SAVENAME.json (multiplayer = server name, singleplayer = save folder name), next to poi_blocks.json.
Purpose: a map-reset tool can check whether anyone is inside an area before wiping it, and kick those players first if needed.
Contents: player name, world position, floor, online flag, observation time.
Note: positions are written to disk - enable this only when the server is actually paired with such a tool.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapPlayerExportIn:
How often the player position file is rewritten, in seconds (default 5).
Only matters when Export player position file is enabled.
The write is small; 5 seconds is negligible for the server.
Higher values save I/O but leave external tools with older positions - reset tools use the in-file timestamp to judge freshness and refuse to act on stale data.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapExportOfflineP: Also export offline players' last position

Besides online players, write the last observed position of offline players into the same file.
Reset tools use it to skip areas where a character logged out - those characters are still standing there when they next log in.
Note: the offline list is only the subset this mod observed (characters who logged out before it started recording never appear). Use it to confirm that someone IS there, never to prove that nobody is.
When disabled, only online players are exported.
Admin changes take effect immediately after Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowAdminTact:
Off by default.
When on, an admin who holds the CanSeeAll capability can enable Tactical View from the minimap settings window and temporarily ignore these server-wide limits: zombie dots, zombie heatmap, animal icons, vehicle icons, and the zombie / animal / vehicle / POI / custom zone display distances plus the global distance cap.
Three conditions must all hold: this option on, the player holds CanSeeAll, and the player turns the switch on themselves (off by default, never automatic).
Never affected by this option (always the server setting): safehouse areas and livestock visibility (those belong to the privacy override), faction target sharing, player position export.
The switch lives only on that player's machine; it affects nobody else and is never written into the server settings.
Takes effect as soon as the admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowAdminPriv:
Off by default. Does nothing unless Allow admin tactical view override is also on.
When on, an admin can add Privacy View on top of Tactical View and temporarily ignore the limits that hide other players' private information: safehouse area / name display and their distance limits, livestock icon visibility.
Four conditions must all hold: both admin options on, the player holds CanSeeAll, and the player turns on both Tactical View and Privacy View themselves.
Turning Tactical View off also disables Privacy View.
Faction target sharing and player position export are never part of any override.
Recommended only for short periods, e.g. handling a dispute or helping recover livestock.
Takes effect as soon as the admin clicks Apply.
